title: Amidala and Her Jedi Allies
front_description: These are dangerous times for the Galactic Senate as troubled leaders ponder the possibility of an interstellar civil war. The assassination attempt on Senator Padmé Amidala adds to the tension, and concerned Jedi Knights, meeting with Chancellor Palpatine, agree that efforts must be made to protect the young Senator.
back_description: Ian McDiarmid sits in the Chancellor's office against a blue screen window
